_note: Base rates used in the outside view. Each entry: what the class is, the rate, how many cases, where it comes from. Update counts with every resolved claim (field 'own_record').

classes.description: European Parliament plenary adopts a provisional trilogue agreement put to a final vote
classes.n: large; failures are rare and usually signalled days ahead
classes.source: Legislative Observatory records, 9th and 10th terms (estimate pending a full count)

classes.description: A non-legislative resolution scheduled for a vote after a plenary debate is adopted that week
classes.source: Plenary minutes (estimate pending a full count); main risk is postponement

classes.description: Czech Chamber approves the state budget in first reading when the government holds a majority
classes.n: every budget since 1993 with a majority government
classes.source: psp.cz voting records; risk is timing (obstruction pushing the vote past the deadline)

classes.description: A ceasefire in the Russia-Ukraine war is announced within 48 hours of a US envoy meeting with Putin
classes.n: about 10 meetings 2025-2026, none followed by a ceasefire within 48 h

classes.description: Sakharov laureate is the finalist backed by the EPP
classes.n: roughly 10 years of decisions; EPP-backed finalist usually wins, sometimes jointly with an ECR or Renew candidate
classes.source: EP press releases 2015-2025 (estimate pending a full count)
